newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crude, products firm in ACCESS trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crude, products firm in ACCESS trade.

text.p: U.S. crude oil and products prices firmed in light after-hours ACCESS trade on Wednesday, with traders waiting for concrete news.
"Everybody's waiting for any kind of news. There's a lack of interest (in trading)," one trader said.
NYMEX October crude traded $24.83 a barrel, up eight cents on 600 lots traded early in the session.
October heating oil firmed about 0.31 cent to 68.50 cents a gallon on 70 lots traded.
Front-month unleaded gasoline was up 0.08 cent at 66 cents a gallon, on 370 lots traded.
